PSn00bSDK-derived GPU font support
=================================

Upstream credit, preserved from the GPU library readme:
PSX GPU library, part of PSn00bSDK
2019 Lameguy64 / Meido-Tek Productions
Licensed under Mozilla Public License

Upstream source revision:
https://github.com/Lameguy64/PSn00bSDK/tree/619fa016bbc4ddd8d4a670cf3f8aa63617473b2f/libpsn00b/psxgpu

License at that revision:
https://github.com/Lameguy64/PSn00bSDK/blob/619fa016bbc4ddd8d4a670cf3f8aa63617473b2f/LICENSE.md
The complete Mozilla Public License 2.0 is included as MPL-2.0.txt.

Covered files in this source distribution:
- port/psx/src/gpu/font.h
- port/psx/src/psx/LIBGPU.C

font.h combines the debug font array from dbugfont.c, font-stream definitions
from font.c, and TIM parsing from gettimimage.c. LIBGPU.C contains adapted
FntLoad, FntPrint, FntOpen and FntFlush routines from font.c alongside existing
PsyCross/TOMB5/Lain GPU code. These combined files are provided under MPL-2.0
as modifications within its file-level scope. They are not offered under an
MPL-or-MIT choice. The original MIT notices for pre-existing MIT portions are
retained in LICENSE, port/psx/LICENSE and thirdparty/TOMB5-LICENSE.txt at the
source-tree root.

Changes inherited through PsyCross and the Lain port include host pointer/type
adaptation, RECT16/TIM field naming, stream handling, drawing synchronization,
GPU integration, and Lain display handling. This license correction adds
notices without changing the executable statements or font bytes.

For every Web build, build_web.py copies the exact covered source files into
sources/port/psx/src/ beneath the distributed Web directory, together with the
applicable licenses. The included README and browser footer identify how to
obtain them. No login, payment, or ROM is needed to retrieve these sources.
Keep sources/ and thirdparty/ with the JS/Wasm files when redistributing or
hosting a build. A link to an unmodified upstream revision is not a substitute
for the actual corresponding modified source.

The 2112-byte dbugfont TIM is also emitted from the array as
sources/port/psx/src/gpu/dbugfont.tim for editing. Its source of origin before
PSn00bSDK has not been independently established; these notices do not grant
rights that upstream contributors did not hold.
